steps.npc: Other goblins in village follow either General Wartface or General Bentnoze. Me try to follow both but then me get left out of both groups.
Me not allowed to talk. Generals will tell me to shut up whenever I talk.
Grubfoot do this! Grubfoot do that! They always want different things and they never satisfied!
Me wish generals wouldn't tell me to shut up.
Sometimes they tell me to shut up when me not even say anything!
Me wish me weren't so small. Other goblins all pick on me and make me do all hard work for generals.

standard-dialogue-after-land-of-the-gobl.npc: Did you go to Land of Goblins?

standard-dialogue-after-land-of-the-gobl.player: Yes, but it wasn't how you'd dreamed. It was a devastated wasteland.

standard-dialogue-after-land-of-the-gobl.npc: Yu'biusk... Land of Goblins... All gone?

standard-dialogue-after-land-of-the-gobl.player: I'm afraid so. And that's not all. Zanik vanished there.
Yes. A bright white light picked her up and then she was gone.

standard-dialogue-after-land-of-the-gobl.npc: She not gone. I sure of it. Someday she return.
